prompt: I'm adding authentication UI to my Next.js 15 (App Router) app using the @remcostoeten/auth-drawer package, which is already installed. My Supabase browser client is exported as `supabase` from `@/lib/supabase`. Set it up end to end: provider at the app root, render the auth drawer, and a header with a 'Sign in' button when logged out and the user's email + a 'Sign out' button when logged in. Write the actual files.

assertions.text: Wraps the app in the real AuthProvider (from the package) with the adapter, and renders <AuthDrawer>
Session/header uses useAuth() (the real hook) rather than a hand-rolled provider/hook
Handles CSS correctly: relies on the package's out-of-the-box styles and does NOT present a manual styles.css import as required
No nonexistent/invented imports or props (no createAdapterError import, no invented hooks/flags)
createSupabaseAdapter receives the supabase client; 'use client' on the client components
